tier_reason: Tier A stands for the RGB8 and L8 rows. Enricher correction: the RGB8 Box row (2.65 ms versus libvips 61.51 ms) is a harness artefact, because libvips 8.15.1 vips_shrink with a non-integer factor does a box pre-shrink by 5 followed by a Lanczos3 reduce, which is why 61.51 ms exceeds libvips' own Lanczos3 time of 17.31 ms; the row is dropped from the claim. The lead also depends on AVX2: the SSE4.1 path loses RGB8 Bilinear and Bicubic to libvips (5.83 vs 5.58 ms, 10.34 vs 9.92 ms) and on arm64 Neoverse-N1 libvips wins Bilinear (26.85 vs 29.21 ms) with the NEON Lanczos3 lead only 1.10x.

corrections.claimed_speedup: RGB8 Lanczos3: 13.52 ms (AVX2) vs libvips 17.31 ms (about 1.28x, derived from page data), image 176.09 ms, resize 137.70 ms. RGB8 Bilinear: 3.55 ms vs libvips 5.58 ms (about 1.57x). RGBA8 Lanczos3: 24.08 ms vs libvips 332.42 ms (libvips resampling in float after premultiply) and resize 218.65 ms. The RGB8 Box row (2.65 ms vs 61.51 ms) is not like-for-like: libvips vips_shrink with a non-integer factor runs a box pre-shrink plus a Lanczos3 reduce. The large margins are against the pure-Rust crates; on SSE4.1-only x86 and on arm64 Neoverse-N1 libvips wins the Bilinear and Bicubic RGB8 rows and the NEON Lanczos3 lead is 1.10x.
